freeze_posture: Canon v12.6 stabilization window: 2026-08-15 through 2027-02-15; defects and material evidence only

changes.change: Structural coherence remains load-bearing while provisional UCI is explicitly diagnostic and may not by itself determine high-stakes CSV passage/failure or convert non-decisive RLS into deterministic selection.

RMCI_L remains an optional heuristic over ordinal profile levels; public summaries omit it by default and may not render it as percentage capacity, cardinal rank, moral rank, leaderboard, or authority score. Qualified RMCP-P100 reference terms are preferred.
Weight floors are labelled adjacent to the values as chosen, challengeable governance priors rather than discovered empirical constants; post-outcome tuning is prohibited.

changes.class: machine conformance hardening of an existing rule
changes.change: Added RIGHTS_RELEVANT_EFFECT_UNROUTED to the Canon registry and WDBIP schema/validator, with one positive example update and one expected-failure fixture.
Added a whole-corpus Source Verification Log, manually verified recent/high-risk references, and removed literal placeholder URLs.
Declared a six-month Canon v12.6 stabilization window prioritizing independent replay, inter-rater studies, RLS/WDBIP/UCI measurement work, and pilots over specification churn.

explicit_nonchanges: No change to RG -> RF/NCRC -> TRC -> CSV -> RLS
No change to rights thresholds or rights coverage sets
No change to TRC equations, alpha values, p_floor, or corridors
No change to RLS equations or decisiveness threshold
No removal of RMCP, RMCI_L, or RMCP-P100; only bounded public-rendering safeguards
No new gate, Union Scope, Welfare Dimension, right, authority layer, or ontology
